data: Are there any red '+' symbols plotted outside the blue boxes in either of the two groups shown in Figure 6?

Looking at the figure, I need to:
1. Identify the red '+' symbols (which represent outliers)
2. Look for these symbols outside the blue boxes (which represent interquartile ranges)

In both group-1 and group-2 plots:
- There are red '+' symbols visible above the upper whiskers of some boxes
- These red '+' symbols appear to be outside the blue boxes

Therefore, yes, there are red '+' symbols plotted outside the blue boxes in both groups.
